name: channel-firehose-small-payload
description: One link's channel saturated with windowed small messages for a fixed wall-time - the same data shape as link-firehose, carried through Reticulum's Channel instead of the bare link: sequenced, msgtype-tagged delivery whose send window opens at the RTT tier, grows one step per proof toward a tiered ceiling, and shrinks one step per loss. Against link-firehose - the identical payload over the raw link - the contrast isolates what the Channel envelope and its adaptive window cost, and whether the window earns the throughput back.
conformance: sent == delivered + timeouts; the channel's own send window paces emission, so window-full backpressure is retried rather than counted - only an exhausted retransmit budget settles a timeout
